groups.common: Muted line at the top of the Group by menu: the part every file name has in common ({text}, e.g. «MQ*T00»).
groups.dnd.over: Spoken (live region) while a file is dragged over a group header of the side list; {g} = group name, {n} = files that would move.
groups.dnd.overNone: Spoken while files are dragged over the Ungrouped target; {n} = files that would leave their group.
groups.dnd.overFiles: Spoken while files dragged in from the desktop are over a group header; {g} = group name.
groups.dnd.overOnto: Spoken while a dragged file rests on the middle of another file that is in no group: dropping makes a group of the two.
groups.with.menu: Entry of the file menu: the keyboard way to drop a file onto another one.
groups.with.prompt: Question of the «Group with…» box; the file names are offered while typing.
groups.with.none: Spoken when the typed text names no file or several.
groups.undo.by: Name of the undo step after «Group by».
groups.undo.then: Name of the undo step after «Then by».
groups.undo.token: Name of the undo step after grouping by token position.
groups.undo.contains: Name of the undo step after grouping by words contained.
groups.undo.none: Name of the undo step after «None».
groups.undo.move: Name of the undo step after a file moves to a group or out of it.
groups.undo.join: Name of the undo step after a file is dropped onto a grouped file.
groups.undo.new: Name of the undo step after a file is dropped onto an ungrouped file.
groups.undo.rename: Name of the undo step after a group is renamed.
groups.undo.ungroup: Name of the undo step after a group is ungrouped.
groups.dnd.doneFiles: Spoken after files from the desktop are dropped on a group header; they join it as they are read.
groups.tab.grip: Tooltip of the grip of a row of the loading table (the handle to drag the file onto a group).
groups.tab.fold: Label of the fold button of a group header of the loading table; {g} = group name.
groups.tab.open: Label of the unfold button of a folded group header of the loading table; {g} = group name.
groups.tab.count: Number of files of a group, shown in its header row of the loading table.
groups.dnd.done: Spoken after files were dropped into a group; {g} = group name.
groups.dnd.doneNone: Spoken after files were dropped on the Ungrouped target.
groups.dnd.cancel: Spoken when a drag between groups is cancelled with Esc.
groups.dnd.edge: Spoken when Ctrl+Shift+Up/Down finds no further group.
groups.move.menu: Entry of the file row menu that opens the list of groups to move the file(s) to.
groups.move.new: Entry of the Move to group list: asks a name and puts the file(s) in a new group.
groups.move.none: Entry of the Move to group list and name of the Ungrouped drop target: the file(s) leave their user group.
groups.clash: Note shown when a group name is refused because another group already has it (case, spaces and underscores ignored); {g} is the refused name.
groups.move.prompt: Question of the box that asks the name of a new group when files are moved to it.
groups.has.multi: Warning under the preview of «Contains…»: {n} files contain more than one of the words and are put in the group of the first.
